applicability: Every curator entry ingested from the orchestrator's hand-off list.

evidence: Evidence: The task-collaboration doctrine this repository works under states the JSON is the source of truth and the markdown is generated and never parsed back (ar-coordination/tasks/AGENTS.md, 'Task Authoring Is Authoritative'); the writer that renders the projection is the cited owner.

statement: A task document's JSON file is the authored source of truth and its Markdown is a generated projection that is never parsed back, so a hand edit made only to the generated file changes nothing the product reads.
